mapper.select: select dept_id from sys_dept where del_flag = '0' and find_in_set(#{deptId}, ancestors)
mapper.update: update sys_dept set ancestors = replace(ancestors, concat(#{oldAncestors}, ',', #{deptId}), concat(#{newAncestors}, ',', #{deptId})) where del_flag = '0' and ancestors like concat(#{oldAncestors}, ',', #{deptId}, '%')
